summary: At the recorded base, the real sglang console entry function rejected --config before YAML model-path parsing. At exact candidate commit 9038ebdca6547819590298996112fa2f59309bab, the existing ConfigArgumentMerger supplies the YAML model path for backend detection; the candidate regression and independent dispatch/precedence/boundary cases passed.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9f8e1f850487/venv/bin/python -c 'import sys; from sglang.cli.main import main; sys.argv=["sglang","serve","--config","/job/review-evidence/base/config.yaml"]; main()' (base)
tests.what_was_measured: The actual registered console entry function and serve implementation failed before server argument parsing with 'Error: --model-path is required', reproducing the original issue.
All 17 focused CLI/backend tests passed at the exact candidate commit, including its config-only regression, CLI precedence, alias, malformed-config, and missing-config cases.

Independent real-entrypoint dispatch showed YAML-only model_path and host reaching ServerArgs; separate assertions verified explicit CLI precedence, YAML model alias support, and absent/malformed model boundaries. Only the final run_server call was captured.

remaining_limitations: No model weights were loaded and no HTTP request or inference was executed; verification ends at the real ServerArgs launch boundary.
The prepared environment is ROCm 7.2/gfx950 rather than the reporter's CUDA 13.0 container, although the changed code is architecture-neutral Python argument handling.
The prepared virtual environment had no installed sglang console executable; the registered entry function sglang.cli.main:main was invoked with equivalent exact argv.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes only Python, tests, and reports and repository-environment.json declares no native artifact.
